collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: Something has walked on a villager's roof every night for a week: go out with a torch, or decide not to know.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every night for a week, something has been walking on (name1)'s roof. Pat, pat, pat. Then a pause. Then pat, pat, pat. Then a strange, soft, gurgling noise. (name1) lies awake listening, imagining all sorts of things. Tonight (he/she) has decided to find out.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) creeps out with a torch and holds it up to the roof. Two seabirds are standing on the thatch, side by side, looking down at (him/her) in the torchlight like a pair of affronted elders. One of them makes the gurgling noise. (name1) goes back to bed. (He/She) sleeps very well, now that (he/she) knows it's just two very rude birds.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) decides that whatever it is, it's not doing any harm. (He/She) lies in bed and listens: pat, pat, pat, pause, gurgle. After a few nights (he/she) starts to find it comforting. When it stops, a few weeks later, (name1) lies awake missing it. (He/She) never does find out what it was.
